API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIIntermediate CA CertificatesIntermediate Cert Resource Download Csr
Intermediate Cert Resource Download Csr
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/intermediateCaCertificate/downloadCsr/:certId

Downloads a Certificate Signing Request (CSR) for the specified ID. To perform this operation, a CSR must have already been generated.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
certId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the intermediate CA certificate.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation
